title.value: The generalizability of pre-processing techniques on the accuracy and fairness of data-driven building models: A case study
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: The generalizability of pre-processing techniques on the accuracy and fairness of data-driven building models: A case study

extractions.description: The paper discusses the use of data-driven building models (DDBMs) to predict lighting status in buildings and proposes a sequentially balanced sampling (SBS) technique to improve the fairness and accuracy of these models. It compares SBS with other pre-processing techniques to balance training datasets and improve predictive performance under different data distribution conditions.
